telemetryCaveat: lib/contract-model/analyzer/telemetry.ts's rate card only knows Sonnet and Opus prices, so the cost each record's own telemetry would compute is wrong for a substituted model. Every figure here is recomputed from the gateway's published per-token price for the model that actually served the call. The production file was not changed to fix this.
